_note: 02-card-3ds-stripe: Stripe 3DS. confirm (only for intents created with authentication_type three_ds) returns requires_customer_action + next_action.redirect_to_url on the router's /payments/redirect endpoint, like the real router. That endpoint is answered with an auto-submitting GET form to hooks.stripe.com/3d_secure_2/hosted (modelled on the router's RedirectForm::Form page); the Stripe page itself is the hermetic blank-document stub. The challenge is never interacted with, so nothing Stripe-side is faked beyond the URL.

routes.name: paymentRedirect
routes.body: <!doctype html><html><head><title>Redirecting</title></head><body><form id="payment_form" method="GET" action="https://hooks.stripe.com/3d_secure_2/hosted"><input type="hidden" name="merchant" value="acct_hermetic"><input type="hidden" name="payment_intent" value="pi_hermetic_synthetic"><input type="hidden" name="payment_intent_client_secret" value="pi_hermetic_synthetic_secret_redacted"><input type="hidden" name="publishable_key" value="pk_test_redacted"><input type="hidden" name="source" value="payatt_hermetic"></form><script>document.getElementById("payment_form").submit();</script></body></html>
